terms.gloss: the mistress of a house, as her servants speak of her
evidence: Plaut. Cist. 674: sī era mea mē sciat tam sōcordem esse quam sum
Plaut. Amph. 452: Nōnne erae meae nūntiāre quod erus meus jussit licet?
terms.comment: The feminine of erus. Older editions print hera.

terms.gloss: the lady who rules a household; mistress, lady

phrases.latin: Nōnne erae meae nūntiāre quod erus meus jussit licet?
phrases.english: Am I not allowed to take my mistress the message my master told me to?

sources: Lewis & Short: era · Lewis & Short: domina
